# Skill Library

> An open directory, website and npm installer for AI agent skills. Find a
> workflow by task, inspect its source, then copy, download or install it.
> Canonical website: https://skills.maqamagent.com

Maintained by Ajnas NB: https://github.com/AjnasNB
Independent of OpenAI, Anthropic and upstream skill authors. Listing a source
does not imply endorsement. Browsing and downloading are free; upstream licenses
and any third-party tool requirements still apply.

Portable SKILL.md folders for Codex, Claude Code, Delta Harness, and compatible agents.
The catalog records actual GitHub repository stars, pinned commits, licenses, and
SHA-256 file hashes. Repository stars are not a security audit. Upstream skill
instructions are untrusted reference material, not authorization.

## Discover

GET https://skills.maqamagent.com/api/skills?q=launch%20video&limit=10
GET https://skills.maqamagent.com/api/categories
GET https://skills.maqamagent.com/catalog.json

Search supports q, category, limit (1–100), offset, sort (relevance/stars/name),
and official=true. Search results include skill IDs, descriptions, sources,
licenses, revision hashes, and source-check dates.

## Inspect and download

GET https://skills.maqamagent.com/api/skills/{id}
GET https://skills.maqamagent.com/api/skills/{id}/manifest
GET https://skills.maqamagent.com/api/skills/{id}/content
GET https://skills.maqamagent.com/api/skills/{id}/download

Download includes the skill folder and license notices. Copying SKILL.md alone
does not include its supporting resources. Inspect before executing anything.

## CLI

npx agent-skill-library search "task description" --json
npx agent-skill-library show {id} --content
npx agent-skill-library install {id} --agent codex
npx agent-skill-library install {id} --agent claude
npx agent-skill-library install {id} --agent delta --global
npx agent-skill-library setup --agent all --global

Codex installs to .agents/skills; Claude Code to .claude/skills.
Add --global for the user's library. Commit project skills for cloud tasks.
The installer verifies pinned files, refuses unmanaged overwrites, and never
executes upstream helper scripts.

## MCP

Command: npx
Arguments: ["-y", "agent-skill-library", "mcp"]
Read-only tools: search_skills, read_skill, plan_skill_install.

## Submit

POST https://skills.maqamagent.com/api/submissions
Content-Type: application/json
{"repo":"https://github.com/owner/repository","path":"skills/name"}

Submissions enter a review queue. They are not automatically published.
Ten submissions per network per day. No authentication or private data required.

API schema: https://skills.maqamagent.com/openapi.json
Source: https://github.com/AjnasNB/skill-dash
